messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - Inference latency spike (>5s p95) for service `svc-inference-eu`. Alert triggered at 2026-03-17T02:13:09Z. Pager routed to @sasha. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-317

sasha: ack — I'm on it. Initial symptoms: elevated queue depth, timeouts observed in frontend logs.

alex: saw customer 502s in grafana alert group 'frontend-errors'. Which pools are we hitting?

maya: @sasha customers reporting 502s and slow responses for generate endpoints since ~02:05Z. Impacting ~3 tenants (high-traffic).

sasha: quick triage: running query for queue depth + hpa.

sasha: `query: sum(rate(inference_queue_depth[1m])) by (pool)` -> queue spiked to ~3100 requests across eu pools.

raj: GPU pool metrics: `gpu-pool-eu-1` at 98% utilization, `gpu-pool-eu-2` at 96%. PodsPending due to node scale in progress.

eli: running `kubectl get hpa -n inference` — posting output:
```
NAME               REFERENCE            TARGETS         MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
infer-hpa          Deployment/infer     60%/CPU         2         50        6          12d
batch-hpa          Deployment/batch     30%/CPU         1         20        1          3d
```
Note: infer-hpa current CPU ~58% so desiredReplicas stayed 6. CPU-based HPA didn't trigger despite queue growth.

sasha: that matches hypothesis H1 — HPA uses CPU so token-generation waiting on GPU doesn't reflect CPU pressure. Need scale-by-queue.

ops-bot: Log snippet pushed to thread (filtered):
```
[02:06:14Z] infer-pod-42 WARN warmup: model shard init delayed: imagePullBackOff
[02:06:19Z] infer-pod-17 ERROR kvcache: miss - loading weights (block 3/12)
[02:07:01Z] frontend-1 502 gateway_response: downstream timeout after 4000ms
```

raj: adding more context — registry had a pull rate limit spike at ~02:04Z in EU region, causing container starts to be delayed. Nodes were requested but containers not ready -> warmup delay.

alex: So we have 3 compounding issues: HPA not sensitive to queue, GPU pool near-saturation, registry/image pull causing warmup delays.

maya: Customer impact note for post-incident: outages/partial degradations for three tenants between 02:05-02:18Z with increased latency and some 502s. We should capture exact request counts per tenant.

eli: Mitigations applied: 1) manual scale: `kubectl scale deployment infer --replicas=20 -n inference` 2) manual add GPU nodes via autoscaling API (requested +6 nodes) 3) enable fallback routing to smaller-model variant for non-critical tenants.

sasha: after manual scale and node add, queue drained to <200 by ~02:22Z and 502s subsided. Latency p95 dropped to ~850ms.

ops-bot: Timeline (automated):
- 02:04:52Z alert threshold crossed
- 02:05:10Z first customer 502 logged
- 02:06:00Z queue depth >3000
- 02:09:30Z manual scale initiated
- 02:12:10Z node add request accepted by cloud provider
- 02:22:15Z queue drained below 200, latency improving

raj: Hypotheses to track in RCA: H1: HPA CPU metric not representative -> underprovisioning during GPU-backed bursts. H2: Registry rate limits causing container warmup delays -> nodes not usable fast enough. H3: Batching/backpressure config allowed queue to grow too large before shedding.

alex: Data pulls needed (assign owners):
- `sasha` -> collect HPA events and metrics for 24h (H1)
- `raj` -> GPU pool allocation timeline + cloud scale events (H2)
- `eli` -> registry/CRR logs and image pull error counts (H2)
- `maya` -> tenant request-level error counts & impacted customer list (impact stmt)

sasha: created incident issue INC-2026-317 and added above owners. I'll start HPA metric dump.

maya: brief customer-facing note drafted: "We experienced increased latency and intermittent 502s for a subset of customers between 02:05-02:22Z due to capacity warmup delays and autoscaling lag. Root cause under investigation. We'll follow up with RCA." — needs review before send.

eli: quick mitigations we should consider permanently: switch infer-hpa to a custom scaler based on queue depth + GPU utilization, prewarm more kernels during low traffic windows, and add image pull retry/backoff improvements.

sasha: handing off to night oncall @alex at 02:30Z. I'll add my notes to the incident timeline in the ticket.

alex: ack handoff. I'll monitor the cloud scale logs and kick off a test to reproduce warmup path. If anything else pops, ping pager. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Reminder: mark incident page as "acknowledged" and set severity/impact fields in INC-2026-317.

sasha: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: RCA draft in the ticket, postmortem meeting scheduled at 2026-03-18 15:00Z.
